headline: Indian stock markets closed today for Diwali-Balipratipada; benchmark indices sat near eight-month highs in last trading session.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 11 November.

why: Indian stock markets (BSE and NSE) are closed today on account of Diwali-Balipratipada.
In the previous trading sessions, Sensex and Nifty surged over 6% to reach their highest levels in over eight months.
India VIX jumped 68% over three weeks despite the 7% rally in benchmark indices.
Equity trading will resume on Wednesday, 11 November, while MCX opens for the evening session.
whatHappening: Cochin Shipyard declared a dividend despite reporting a 50% decline in Q2 profit.
MRF reported a 28% drop in net profit for the second quarter.
Citi revised price targets upward for IT services firms Wipro, TCS, and HCLTech.
Nalco clarified that three workers who died at a Tata Electronics site were hired by a sub-contractor.
summary: Indian equity markets are closed today, 10 November 2026, for Diwali-Balipratipada. In the last trading session, Sensex and Nifty extended gains to hit their highest levels in over eight months. Earnings announcements remain in focus with quarterly results from Cochin Shipyard and MRF.
